Architecture: plain GCNN, 4 layers x 6 feature maps, space-group symmetrized; no parameter count given. Energy = -0.560313(3) per site x 144 (Table III, J2 = 0, N = 36, GCNN column, no Lanczos step). || parameters = 49386 evaluated (4-layer plain GCNN, 36-site triangular, point group C6v order 12): NetKet GCNN with spin parity and input/hidden masks = embedding F*n_in + F bias + (L-1) equivariant layers (F^2*n_h + F bias) + (L-1) parity-flip layers (F^2*n_h, no bias, extra_bias=False default) with F = 6 feature maps, L = 4 layers, n_in = 19 kernel sites (Fig. 1, origin included), n_h = 19 x |point group| 12 = 228: 120 + 24642 + 24624 = 49386. Real parameters ("real-valued kernels"), counted the way NetKet's n_parameters counts them (unmasked entries only, NetKet >= 3.7). Independent of N and of |G|: the masked kernels depend only on the cluster size and the point-group order, so the count changes across rows only through the depth L. Assumptions and their size: (i) spin parity doubles the hidden kernels (the paper's symmetry group is space group x Z2 parity and it labels irreps with ±; without the parity-flip layers the count would be 24762); (ii) biases are the NetKet default use_bias=True (24 parameters; not stated in the paper); (iii) "in most cases" the embedding is local; a full-range embedding (n_in = 36) would give 49488; (iv) with NetKet < 3.7 (e.g. at v1, Nov 2022) masked kernels were stored full-size (F x F x |G|) and multiplied by the mask, so n_parameters would print a larger number of which only the above are free. Consistency check: LayerSR (App. C) requires fewer samples than parameters per layer; with parity one triangular layer pair has 2 x 6 x 6 x 228 + 6 = 16422 parameters, just above the 16384 samples used there, without parity 8214 would not be. Existing samples = 4096 / iterations = 1500 checked: v2 Sec. IV states 4096 samples and approx. 1500 steps for the 36-site models, and the row energy is the v2 value (-0.560313(3) x 144). v1 stated 8192 samples per SR iteration for the 36-site runs (v1 energy -0.56031(7), an earlier run, not this row). Kept 4096.
